name: Entain PLC
reason: Gambling operator whose adjusted EPS is flat (GBP 0.56 in 2015 vs 0.62 in 2025; 10y CAGR 0.9%) despite revenue built by acquisition (acq/FCF 1.31, shares +25.8%/yr), with negative 10y average ROIC and ongoing UK/regulatory and compliance exposure.

name: Safestore Holdings plc
reason: Self-storage REIT with net debt/EBITDA of 7.8x, NTM FFO consensus flat (FY1 -0.1%, FY2-3 +2.5%/+6.5%) and EPS 0.56x its 10y max; rate-sensitive property earnings with no route to 7%/yr.

name: Princes Group Plc
reason: Recently listed canned-food maker with EBIT margins of 0.8-4.0% (latest 4.0% is its 100th pctile), only one year of listed EPS (GBP 0.15 in 2025) and acquisition-led growth (acq/FCF 0.95); commodity-input, private-label economics with no specialness.

name: Norsk Hydro ASA
reason: Aluminium producer whose earnings are set by aluminium and energy prices: adjusted EPS swung from NOK 0.52 (2019) to 10.70 (2022) to 5.14 (2025), and consensus FY2-3 is -7%/-10%.

name: Aedifica SA
reason: Healthcare-property REIT whose EUR FFO/share rose only 0.9%/yr over 5 years (4.88 in 2020 to 5.12 in 2025) while shares grew 14.7%/yr, with net debt/EBITDA of 7.9x and consensus FY2-3 of +2.8%/+1.7%.

name: Galp Energia SGPS S.A.
reason: Integrated oil and gas company whose earnings are set by oil prices and refining margins (EPS EUR -0.06 in 2020 vs 1.56 in 2025, now at its 10y max), with consensus FY2-3 of -13%/-17%.

name: Wienerberger AG
reason: Brick/roof-tile/pipe maker tied to the housing and construction cycle: adjusted EPS fell from EUR 5.34 (2022) to 1.52 (2025), 0.28x its peak, and growth has relied on acquisitions (acq/FCF 0.66) with net debt/EBITDA of 2.4x.

name: STEF
reason: Temperature-controlled logistics with a 2.9-5.6% EBIT margin, FCF conversion of 0.37 and acquisition-led growth (acq/FCF 1.2); adjusted EPS fell 40% to EUR 7.37 in 2025 and net debt/EBITDA is 3.7x, so it is ordinary and capital-heavy.

name: Telia Lietuva AB
reason: Lithuanian telco controlled by Telia Company with no consensus coverage; EPS rose from EUR 0.10 (2022) to 0.16 (2025) at a peak EBIT margin of 22.2% (100th pctile) in a mature, regulated market where sustained >=7% growth is unlikely.

name: Iveco Group NV
reason: Truck and bus maker with cyclical earnings (EPS EUR -1.51 in 2020 vs 1.29 in 2024), a 10y average ROIC of 2.7%, a short standalone history since the 2022 spin-off and a pending change of control; no durable moat.

name: Zalando SE
reason: Online fashion retailer with a 3.2% average EBIT margin and a 10y average ROIC of 5.3%; adjusted EPS is volatile (EUR 0.06 in 2022 vs 1.11 in 2024) and the near-term growth comes from consolidating the About You acquisition, not a durable moat.

name: Springer Nature AG & Co. KGaA
reason: Scientific publisher with a 22.5% EBIT margin (at its 100th pctile) but only 6 years of erratic GAAP EPS (EUR -0.05 in 2021 vs 1.79 in 2025), Holtzbrinck control, and a hard-to-size open-access and AI threat to journal economics.

name: Gecina SA
reason: Paris office/residential REIT whose EUR FFO/share grew only 1.9%/yr over 10 years (5.53 to 6.68), with net debt/EBITDA of 10.4x and consensus FY2-3 of -0.7%/+3.6%; rate-sensitive and growth falls short of 7%.

name: Amundi SA
reason: Asset manager with a good record (adjusted EPS EUR 3.03 to 6.58, 8.0%/yr over 10 years), but EPS is 0.97x its peak, fees follow capital markets and passive pricing pressure, it is controlled by Credit Agricole, and consensus FY2-3 is only +3.3%/+4.5%.

name: Huhtamaki Oyj
reason: Food-service and flexible packaging maker whose adjusted EPS grew only 4.6%/yr (EUR 1.62 to 2.54), with flat 7.5-9.0% EBIT margins, FCF conversion of 0.67, partly acquired growth and single-use plastic regulation risk.

name: BB Biotech AG
reason: Listed biotech investment holding company whose 'earnings' are portfolio mark-to-market gains (EPS CHF -14.00 in 2016, 12.42 in 2017, -8.51 in 2018), so its earnings power cannot be forecast.

name: Sportradar Group AG
reason: Sports-data and betting-technology supplier with real network assets, but GAAP EPS has only grown since 2023 (EUR 0.03 to 0.31), it trades at 24.7x NTM, it depends on renewing league rights such as NBA/MLB, it faces sports-betting regulatory and litigation risk, and acq/FCF is 0.73.

name: Loomis AB
reason: Cash-in-transit operator in a structurally declining cash market; adjusted EPS grew only 4.1%/yr over 10 years (SEK 15.47 to 23.21), with a -56.5% year in 2020 and heavy USD translation exposure.

name: ALSO Holding AG
reason: IT distributor with a 1.2-1.8% EBIT margin whose adjusted EPS has been flat since 2021 (CHF 12.19 vs 10.01 in 2025); it is a low-moat intermediary and trades at 17.8x NTM.

name: Aegean Airlines SA
reason: Airline whose 10-year average EBIT margin is 1.1% (-55.5% in 2020), with earnings exposed to fuel, tourism and shocks; consensus FY1 is -30.7%, so it fails the durability test.
